Students Die in Separate Incidents Across India, Investigations Underway

Multiple students have died in separate incidents across India. In Kerala, a 20-year-old engineering student from Arunachal Pradesh was found dead in his rented home, prompting a promise of a detailed probe from a minister. In Tamil Nadu, a nursing student died after jumping from a college building, with her family alleging harassment. Another medical student reportedly died by suicide in Uppal. In Ernakulam, a BTech student was found dead, with fellow students raising concerns about the college's credit system. Protesters in one instance blamed a 'harsh' credit score system for the student's death.
